description: This is a shell script that tests the 'git submodule summary' command. It sets up repositories, adds files and submodules, and verifies the output of submodule summaries under various conditions, including modifications, type changes, deletions, and multiple submodules.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds files to a specified subdirectory, commits each added file, and returns the short SHA of the latest commit.

methods.name: commit_file
methods.description: Creates a commit with the current changes, with message indicating the files involved.
